business_problem: Okta premier support relied on reactive email and chat workflows with long response times, slower resolution, and only about 60% customer satisfaction.
solution_summary: Okta premier support relied on reactive email and chat workflows with long response times, slower resolution, and only about 60% customer satisfaction. Okta implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow University, Customer Service Management, IT Service Management, and Knowledge Base. Key components included ServiceNow University standardizes adoption with role-based training; Customer Service Management manages customer-support cases and self-service; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; Knowledge Base stores reusable support content. Teams learn through ServiceNow University curricula and labs, then apply those patterns in AI agents, portals, and workflow automations running on the ServiceNow platform. Feedback from pilots feeds back into updated training content and delivery playbooks. Running customer support and case management on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier. Okta raised customer satisfaction to 97.
